backstory.v: She leads by making every alternative feel insufficiently organised. Her captain's band makes every corridor disagreement appear to require a formation. Residents are either organised or being organised. A dissonant card has taught her to ask the youngest neighbour where they would prefer to stand. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Sie hat die Führung. Abweichende Richtungen werden freundlich erfasst.

backstory.v: He anticipates every shot as if it were addressed to his childhood. He raises the blockers before the courtyard has decided whether there will be a shot. HyperNorm values readiness until it resembles fear. A contradictory card has persuaded him that asking a neighbour to stand nearby is also protection. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er ist vorbereitet. Das Ereignis wurde noch nicht zugelassen.

backstory.v: He stops the attack mainly because movement offends him. He confiscates the puck to establish that the quickest way to stop trouble is to stop play. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Lage ist ruhig. Das Spielgerät bleibt zur Sicherheit eingezogen.

backstory.v: He sees passing lanes where others have sensibly drawn walls. His three-arrow slate demonstrates that every wall contains an argument for a passing lane. HyperNorm approves movement only after its destination is certain. He has begun offering an open palm before producing the diagram. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Der Weg ist frei. Die Wand wurde noch nicht informiert.

backstory.v: She shoots from distance to avoid the unnecessary intimacy of consultation. She favours a distant shot because discussion tends to add unnecessary defenders. Residents are either supporting or obstructing. A dissonant card has made her pass to a quiet neighbour who expected only to be in the way. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Sie hält Abstand. Der Schuss übernimmt den persönlichen Kontakt.

backstory.v: He is thrilled to be selected and alarmed by the prospect of being needed. The borrowed glove is larger than his understanding of selection criteria. HyperNorm files newcomers as promising or not ready. An ambiguous card has suggested that needing guidance is compatible with belonging, so he keeps asking. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er wurde ausgewählt. Die damit verbundenen Folgen überraschen ihn weiterhin.
